limitations: Synthetic source-derived questions and agent labels, not a human user trial.
Question sources exclude all known training groups; global retrieval corpus is shared across document splits.
Added questions were authored after existing34 model outcomes; this is development analysis, not a preregistered independent final test.
Historically source-selected strata are separated from never-source-selected; source freshness differs from unseen documents.
Original202 and existing34 are retrospective benchmarks; old scores/labels remain unchanged.
Three seeds are descriptive; no inferential training-seed confidence interval.
All grades are frozen agent judgments, not human labels or a human user trial.
No final-test or 59-holdout access, no seed/checkpoint/fusion selection, no automatic live promotion.
statistical_interpretation: Paired evidence-group sampling uncertainty conditional on the three realized training seeds and frozen agent labels; not a confidence interval over training seeds, not annotation uncertainty, and not familywise adjusted.

training.seed_variation: Fresh training starts; seeds vary training order/dropout RNG. Head initialization remains fixed at 1234.
